scenarios.serve_cmd:
# Load model from ModelScope to speed up download (skip when using local weights).
export VLLM_USE_MODELSCOPE=True
export HCCL_BUFFSIZE=1024
export HCCL_OP_EXPANSION_MODE="AIV"
export VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=0

# Host-level tuning; skipped gracefully inside the verify container (read-only /sys, no sysctl perms)
echo performance | tee /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu*/cpufreq/scaling_governor 2>/dev/null || true
sysctl -w vm.swappiness=0 2>/dev/null || true
sysctl -w kernel.numa_balancing=0 2>/dev/null || true
sysctl kernel.sched_migration_cost_ns=50000 2>/dev/null || true

  # NOTE (first-party deviation): enable_fused_mc2=1 below deviates from tutorial §9.1 (=2) —
  # the MegaMoe path rejected the dummy-run token count at TP16 on this stack; root cause pending.
vllm serve /root/.cache/modelscope/hub/models/Eco-Tech/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-w8a8-mtp \
  --host 0.0.0.0 \
  --port 8000 \
  --data-parallel-size 1 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 16 \
  --enable-expert-parallel \
  --seed 1024 \
  --quantization ascend \
  --served-model-name qwen3.5 \
  --max-num-seqs 128 \
  --max-model-len 133000 \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 16384 \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 \
  --enable-prefix-caching \
  --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_DECODE_ONLY"}' \
  --additional-config '{"enable_cpu_binding": true, "enable_fused_mc2": 1, "enable_flashcomm1": true}'
